messages:
marco_cs: Heads up — Orion (payments startup) accepted into the Q2 preview cohort. They want to start integration next week. Proposed kickstart call Tues 2027-04-13 10:00am PT. Need enablement + feedback loop plan. @emma_cs @raj_eng

emma_cs: Nice! Can do the call. Quick Q: do they need dedicated capacity or hosted for the preview?

marco_cs: Starting hosted with a pinned model + telemetry. If early traffic spikes we can flip to a small dedicated pool. For preview they asked for data separation notes for legal.

raj_eng: I can own the integration checklist and env setup. Need to know expected qps and approx sample payload sizes. cc @sam_devex for SDKs.

sam_devex: I can prep a 15-min quickstart and a minimal example repo. Also will produce a short troubleshooting doc for their infra team.

olivia_orion: thanks — we can start with ~5rps and payloads avg 3KB, peaks ~20rps. Security wise we need KMS integration + audit logs.

marco_cs: good. For feedback capture: propose weekly check-ins for first 3 weeks, then biweekly. Also a short NPS + 3 targeted prompts after each sprint. Thoughts?

emma_cs: weekly ok. For NPS we should tie to specific prompt sets to catch regressions. I can own the NPS survey + one-click in-console link.

raj_eng: engineering asks for a sample dataset and a couple of failing prompts so we can validate regression detection and telemetry hooks. Olivia, can you share a sanitized sample?

olivia_orion: yes, will sanitize and share by EOD Monday.

sam_devex: draft quickstart will include this curl to mint a preview token (feel free to reuse):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/preview/tokens \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_CLI" \ 
  -d '{"customer":"orion","expires_in":86400}'
```

raj_eng: deployment checklist items I want on the call:
- confirm env keys + KMS scope
- telemetry tags (customer_id, preview_cohort)
- fallback policy (hosted -> small dedicated)
- test prompts + regen tests

marco_cs: tagging agenda: kickstart call (30m) + followups: onboarding doc, quickstart repo, weekly feedback form, enablement recording. I'll schedule. @deploy-bot can you post calendar invite once I create it? :wave:

deploy-bot: Event created: "Orion preview kickstart" Tue Apr 13 10:00am PT — invite sent to olivia_orion, emma_cs, raj_eng, sam_devex, marco_cs :white_check_mark:

emma_cs: I'll prepare a 3-slide enablement deck and share pre-read. Also adding 2 success metrics: time-to-first-successful-query and percentage of requests within latency SLO.

marco_cs: risk note — Orion has renewal review in 6 months. If preview goes well, we should prioritize a dedicated capacity proposal in month 4. Flagging for GTM.

olivia_orion: appreciate the clarity. We'll aim to deliver sample data tomorrow. Looking forward to the call. :thumbsup:

marco_cs: Great—closing the loop. Post-call action owners: emma (enablement + NPS), raj (integration checklist), sam (quickstart repo), olivia (sample data). I’ll post follow-up thread with links and meeting notes. :eyes:
